issues.evidence:
`fhir4ds/sqlquery/errors.py` defines `SQLError(ValueError)`. Recommended inheritance: `SQLError(SQLOnFHIRError)` so consumers catching the existing `viewdef.errors.SQLOnFHIRError` root also catch SQLQuery errors. Since `SQLOnFHIRError` already inherits from `ValueError`, the broader-catch behavior is preserved.

Expected behavior: `except SQLOnFHIRError` catches `SQLQueryParseError`, `SQLQueryValidationError`, `SQLQueryCycleError`, `SQLQueryMaterializationError`, `SQLQueryTypeError`, `UnsupportedDialectError`.

Reproducer: `try: raise SQLQueryParseError('x'); except SQLOnFHIRError: pass` should not propagate.
issues.root_cause: SQLError was defined with `ValueError` parent for backward-compat, bypassing the existing SQLOnFHIRError root in viewdef/errors.py.
issues.resolution: Changed `class SQLError(ValueError)` to `class SQLError(SQLOnFHIRError)` in fhir4ds/sqlquery/errors.py. Imported SQLOnFHIRError from fhir4ds.viewdef.errors. Updated module docstring. Added test_error_hierarchy_inherits_sqlofhiriroot in TestPackageImports verifying issubclass + behavioral catch via except SQLOnFHIRError.
issues.verified_in: fhir4ds/sqlquery/tests/test_smoke.py::TestPackageImports::test_error_hierarchy_inherits_sqlofhiriroot — asserts issubclass(SQLError, SQLOnFHIRError), issubclass(SQLError, ValueError), and except SQLOnFHIRError catches each typed subclass. 29/29 sqlquery tests pass.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2 cnl-0: `^[A-Z]([A-Za-z0-9_]){1,254}$` (2-255 chars). External review finding #10; internal REV-004.
issues.evidence:
`fhir4ds/viewdef/parser.py:validate_view_definition()` checks `not vd.name[0].isupper() or len(vd.name) > 255` for cnl-0 warning. Missing condition: `len(vd.name) < 2`. A name like `'A'` violates cnl-0 (regex requires 2+ chars) but currently passes our warning.

Expected behavior: `validate_view_definition(ViewDefinition(name='A', ...))` returns a warning containing 'cnl-0'.
issues.root_cause: Conservative scoping during initial §G-2 implementation skipped minimum-length enforcement.
issues.resolution: Added `len(vd.name) < 2` to the cnl-0 warning condition in fhir4ds/viewdef/parser.py:validate_view_definition. Updated the test docstring in test_single_char_name_warns to assert the warning fires (previously documented the gap as accepted).
issues.verified_in: fhir4ds/viewdef/tests/unit/test_parser.py::TestCnl0NameWarningPerSpecG2::test_single_char_name_warns — asserts any('cnl-0' in w for w in warnings) for name='A'. 5/5 cnl-0 tests pass.

issues.evidence:

issues.root_cause: Strict equality inherited from prior 134-assertion; updated mechanically during §G-5 refresh without future-proofing.
issues.resolution: Replaced strict `== 144` with `>= MIN_EXPECTED_SPEC_TESTS` (constant = 144) in fhir4ds/viewdef/tests/test_spec_compliance.py. Added helpful error message pointing at upstream URL if floor violated. Existing diagnostic print above still logs the actual count.
